articles.title: Trump says US support for Japanese yen a 'signal of friendship'
articles.summary: 📰 싱가포르 최신 뉴스\n📢 Trump says US support for Japanese yen a 'signal of friendsh...
articles.content: "We're very strong -- very very strong financially. They are, you know, they have a weakening yen, and they wanted a little bit of help. And we're always there for Japan. Japan's been very good to us, with the exception, of course, of Pearl Harbor," the president said.
